name: 30_warpx_planar_crossed_field
title: WarpX comparison E: planar smooth-bore magnetron gap (2D), below / above Hull cutoff

rows.case: B = 0.6 B_H (conducting): electrons in the gap, VEL-PIC / WarpX
B = 1.3 B_H (insulated): electrons in the gap, VEL-PIC / WarpX

notes: V = 10 kV, d = 5 mm, Hull field B_H = 67.77 mT (relativistic planar). Electrons injected at J = 0.25 J_CL with 2 eV normal energy, periodic 8-cell strip along the cathode. WarpX 26.09 2D (XZ, ES labframe, use_filter = 0) vs VEL-PIC 2D-ZY, same dt, shape, pusher and energy-conserving gather. Above B_H all electrons return to the cathode (twice the charge in the gap, the potential depressed near the cathode). Compared after the start-up, t = 1-2.2 ns, while the insulated hub is still laminar (later it develops the 2D diocotron/turbulent hub in both codes).
